# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m159 and modern WebAssembly**

> **API changes** · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/15.0.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159.0 brings Skia m159 and requires .NET 9 or later for WebAssembly native assets. The engine update includes WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements and image/rendering corrections. Non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move WebAssembly consumers off .NET 8** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 9 or later; unsupported WASM frameworks are rejected before building. Upgrade .NET 8 browser applications and use runtime-matched archives: .NET 9/10 use Emscripten 3.1.56, while .NET 11+ use 6.0.2. These archives are not interchangeable with older toolchains. Non-WASM .NET 8 support is unchanged. ([#5700](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5700))

## Engine

- **Skia milestone 159** — Updates the native renderer with WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements and image/rendering correctness fixes. C API exports and public managed signatures are unchanged. ([#5685](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5685))

## HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0.100

HarfBuzzSharp WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 9 or later and retain runtime-matched archives for supported toolchains. Non-WASM .NET 8 support is unchanged.
